contract.market_breadth: ret1 and ma20_gap positive fractions use non-NaN rows only. Median features retain pandas non-NaN median. V1 partial fits are separate and not reused.
contract.absolute_gates: previous actual close<=cap (0 removes cap), previous actual volume>=10000, actual volume>=5000, actual close>=20, current and previous source_usable and 45 complete features
contract.learning: Frozen V7 seed42/160trees/4threads; monthly target_end_date < month_start. Daily top0.25% teacher reranked in each cap's eligible population; existing symbol shift(-5) target kept.
contract.selection: Frozen five shadow selectors, no cooldown or retuning; ambiguous winner causes common-day exclusion across ALL SIX arms/all five modes, training unchanged.
contract.endpoint: Entry signal+1 official bank-business session open; exit signal+5 official bank-business session close. Missing or bad endpoint remains unmeasured; it never moves to a later available quote.
contract.cash: 100 actual shares at entry; build_trade_economics verifies integral quantity after EVERY holding action, excludes unmodeled cash-in-lieu. CashPL uses actual prices; cost0, no fill proof.
contract.limitations: Historical research on the current JPX surviving universe; provider action completeness is not independently certified. Relative source adjustment is assumed after quality checks. Post-hoc cap comparison does not prove live edge. Original published sealed ledger is not rewritten.
